Lemma
[Center spheres of sufficiently good necks bound smooth balls] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0084 ↗ def:chow-iii-embedded-epsilon-neck 1. ch18:18.28\group Necks

There is $\varepsilon (n)>0$ such that, if $(\mathcal N^n,h)$ is complete, noncompact, and has positive sectional curvature, then the center sphere of every embedded $\varepsilon (n)$-neck bounds a smooth $n$-ball in $\mathcal N$.
